description: She is no longer treated as an indigene of her birth state because she has married out, and not accepted as an indigene of her husband's state because she was not born there. Neither position is written down.
energy_note: From two states, and claimed by neither.

aspect: It was one of the five rejected bills
description: The indigeneship bill in WOM-001 would have allowed women to become natives of their husbands' states. It was rejected on 2 March 2022.
energy_note: The fix was proposed, voted on, and refused.

description: State scholarships, civil service quotas, subsidised schooling, land allocation and political candidacy all key off indigeneship certificates.
energy_note: Excluded from the state's own provision, by marrying.

description: The state bursary requires an indigeneship certificate from the local government. Hers says her father's LGA. The registrar says she should apply through her husband's. Her husband's LGA says she is not from there. The deadline is Friday.
energy_note: Two councils, one form, no certificate.

description: The federal character quota allocates the post by state of origin. Her file says Anambra, from her father. She has lived in Kaduna for nineteen years and her children were born there. She competes for the Anambra allocation against people who live there and know the panel.
energy_note: Competing for a place in a state she left at six.
